summary: CORRECTED: the M004 retry guard already existed before this worker's claim. The actual defect is a TOCTOU gap: a case filtered as eligible from stale state can still be claimed after a retry guard becomes durable because playback_queue.claim_case() does not re-evaluate playback_retry_guard at claim time.

correction.supersedes_original_assumption: The original report stated current_retry_guard_present=false. That was stale by claim time and is withdrawn.
correction.proof: The claim commit directly descends from the guard commit, so the guard was already present in the repository state on which the claim was committed.

observed.root_cause_of_media_block: Trusted GHOT archive page exposes no supported public media URL; yt-dlp reports Unsupported URL; real media decode never starts.

risk: A guard created after candidate discovery but before durable claim can be bypassed. Once such a claim exists, request submission and the evidence service can spend resources repeating an environment-change-guarded case.
expected: Retry-guard eligibility must be revalidated against fresh repository state at the authoritative claim boundary (and preferably again before request execution). A newly durable active guard must make the claim fail/retry another candidate rather than allowing the guarded case to proceed.
worker_action: Corrected the factual record and reported the race only. Worker did not modify scripts, workflow, permissions, or retry-guard control plane.
